The '''Rakatan stronghold''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] temple fortress placed under the command of [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] on the planet [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. It served as the Empire's power center in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], from where its expeditions were free to plunder this region of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Dotj1" />

*[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]
